profile_text.body:
Decagon is a company whose website presents it as an AI concierge for customer service. In its own words, it lets businesses build, optimize, and scale AI agents that treat every customer like the only one. The site says leading brands use the product to go beyond traditional support, offering personalized experiences across the entire customer lifecycle, and it highlights testing, observability, and experimentation so that an agent's logic can be validated and iterated on as it evolves.

The company's product is also named Decagon, described as a customer support agent platform that is omnichannel and model-agnostic, with monitoring through a feature called Watchtower. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
